description: Advance a session through the Servicialo lifecycle: confirm, start, complete, or mark as no-show. NOTE: the "deliver" action is NOT available via MCP (ref PDC-SEC-001) — MCP authentication cannot validate actor-as-Proveedor. Delivery must be performed via the REST endpoint PATCH /api/organizations/[orgSlug]/coordinalo/sessions/[sessionId]/deliver which enforces provider binding.
